operations.name: Create an api key
operations.description: Create a new personal API key for the authenticated user. The full key `value` is only returned in this response and cannot be retrieved again, so it should be stored securely.

name.description: A name to identify the API key.

scope.description: An optional list of scopes to restrict which endpoints the key can access.

operations.description: Permanently revoke an API key. Any requests made with the key afterwards will be rejected.

id.description: Unique identifier for the API key.

operations.name: List api keys
operations.description: List API keys for the authenticated user, or for all users in the workspace when called by an administrator. The secret key `value` is never included in this response.

operations.name: Create an attachment

documentId.description: Identifier for the associated document, if any.

size.description: Size of the file attachment in bytes.

documentId.description: Identifier for the associated document, if any.

id.description: An optional client-generated identifier for the attachment.

operations.description: Deleting an attachment is permanent. It will not delete references or links to the attachment that may exist in your documents.

id.description: Unique identifier for the attachment.

operations.name: List all attachments
operations.description: List all attachments in the workspace, optionally filtered by the document or user they are associated with.

operations.name: Retrieve an attachment

id.description: Unique identifier for the attachment.

operations.description: Retrieve authentication options

operations.description: This method allows you to give all members in a group access to a collection.

operations.name: Add a collection user
operations.description: This method allows you to add a user membership to the specified collection.

id.description: Identifier for the collection

userId.description: Identifier for the user to add to the collection

operations.name: Archive a collection
operations.description: Archiving a collection hides it, and all of the documents within it, from the sidebar and search results. Archived collections can be restored at a later date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection.

operations.name: Create a collection
operations.description: Create a new collection with the specified name, description, icon, color, and permission settings. Collections are used to organize documents.

description.description: A brief description of the collection, markdown supported. Only one of `description` or `data` may be provided.

data.description: The collection description as a rich-text ProseMirror JSON document. Only one of `description` or `data` may be provided.

icon.description: A string that represents an icon in the outline-icons package or an emoji

color.description: A hex color code for the collection icon

sharing.description: Whether public sharing of documents is allowed

operations.name: Delete a collection
operations.description: Delete a collection and all of its documents. This action can’t be undone so please be careful.

operations.name: Retrieve a collections document structure
operations.description: Returns the document structure of a collection as a tree of navigation nodes, representing the hierarchy of documents within the collection.

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection.

operations.name: Duplicate a collection
operations.description: Duplicate an existing collection along with its published documents. The original collection's settings – icon, color, permission, sharing, and sorting – are preserved on the copy. Draft and archived documents are not duplicated. Document duplication runs asynchronously in the background, so the copy may initially be returned before all of its documents have been created.

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection to duplicate.

name.description: An optional name for the new collection. If omitted, the original collection's name is reused.

operations.name: Export a collection
operations.description: Triggers a bulk export of the collection in markdown format and their attachments. If documents are nested then they will be nested in folders inside the zip file. The endpoint returns a `FileOperation` that can be queried to track the progress of the export and get the url for the final file.

operations.name: Export all collections
operations.description: Triggers a bulk export of multiple collections and their documents. The endpoint returns a `FileOperation` that can be queried through the fileOperations endpoint to track the progress of the export and get the url for the final file.

includeAttachments.description: Whether to include attachments in the export.

includePrivate.description: Whether to include private collections in the export.

operations.name: List all collection group members
operations.description: This method allows you to list a collections group memberships. This is the list of groups that have been given access to the collection.

operations.name: Import documents into a new collection

attachmentId.description: Identifier for the attachment that contains the file to import.

format.description: The format of the file being imported.

operations.description: Retrieve the details of a collection by its unique identifier.

id.description: Unique identifier for the collection.

anchorSuffix.description: Text immediately following `anchorText`, used to disambiguate between multiple occurrences. Requires `anchorText`.

operations.description: Retrieve a chronologically sorted array of activity rollups (views, comments, reactions, revisions, editors) for a document. operations.description: Creates a new share link that can be used by to access a document or collection. If you request multiple shares for the same resource with the same API key, the same share object will be returned. By default all shares are unpublished. Exactly one of `documentId` or `collectionId` must be provided.

documentId.description: Identifier for the document to share. Mutually exclusive with `collectionId`.

collectionId.description: Identifier for the collection to share. Mutually exclusive with `documentId`.

operations.name: Retrieve a share object
operations.description: Retrieve the details of a share link by its unique identifier or by the associated document ID. Shares allow documents to be accessed publicly or by specific users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the share.

documentId.description: Unique identifier for a document. One of id or documentId must be provided.

operations.name: List all shares
operations.description: List all share links in the workspace.

operations.name: Revoke a share
operations.description: Makes the share link inactive so that it can no longer be used to access the document.

operations.name: Update a share
operations.description: Allows changing an existing share's published status, which removes authentication and makes it available to anyone with the link.

title.description: Override title displayed on the publicly shared page. If not set the source document or collection title is used.

iconUrl.description: URL of an icon to display on the publicly shared page, overriding the workspace branding.

operations.name: Create a star
operations.description: Stars a document or collection so it appears in the users sidebar. One of either `documentId` or `collectionId` must be provided.

operations.name: Delete a star
operations.description: Remove a star from a document, removing it from the user's starred documents list in the sidebar.

operations.name: List all stars
operations.description: List all starred documents for the authenticated user. Stars allow users to bookmark important documents for quick access in the sidebar.

operations.name: Update a stars order in the sidebar
operations.description: Update the position of a starred document in the sidebar. The index parameter determines the display order relative to other starred documents.

operations.name: Create a subscription
operations.description: Subscribe the authenticated user to a document or collection so that they receive notifications when it changes. Provide exactly one of `documentId` or `collectionId`.

event.description: The type of event to subscribe to.

documentId.description: The document to subscribe to. Provide exactly one of documentId or collectionId.

collectionId.description: The collection to subscribe to. Provide exactly one of documentId or collectionId.

operations.name: Delete a subscription
operations.description: Unsubscribe the authenticated user from a document or collection by the subscription's identifier.

id.description: Unique identifier for the subscription.

operations.name: Retrieve a subscription
operations.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's subscription for a specific document or collection, if one exists.

event.description: The type of event that is subscribed to.

documentId.description: The subscribed document. Provide exactly one of documentId or collectionId.

collectionId.description: The subscribed collection. Provide exactly one of documentId or collectionId.

operations.name: List subscriptions
operations.description: List the authenticated user's subscriptions for a given document or collection.

operations.name: Create a template
operations.description: Create a new template that can be used as a starting point for new documents. Templates can optionally be scoped to a specific collection.

id.description: Optionally provide a specific UUID for the template.

title.description: The title of the template. Required when publishing.

data.description: The body of the template as a Prosemirror document. Required when publishing.

icon.description: An emoji to use as the template icon.

color.description: The color of the template icon in hex format.

collectionId.description: Identifier for the collection to which the template belongs.

publish.description: Whether the template is available to other members. Set to false to create a draft that is only visible to its creator.

operations.name: Delete a template
operations.description: Delete a template by its unique identifier. This will soft-delete the template, it can be restored later.

id.description: Unique identifier for the template. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

operations.name: Duplicate a template
operations.description: Create a copy of an existing template. Optionally override the title and target collection.

id.description: Unique identifier for the template to duplicate. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

title.description: Override the title of the duplicated template.

collectionId.description: Identifier for the collection to place the duplicated template in. If not provided, uses the original template's collection.

operations.name: Retrieve a template
operations.description: Retrieve a template by its unique identifier.

id.description: Unique identifier for the template. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

operations.name: List all templates
operations.description: List all templates available to the current user. Optionally filter by collection. Templates not associated with a collection are workspace-wide.

operations.name: Restore a template
operations.description: Restore a previously deleted template by its unique identifier.

id.description: Unique identifier for the template. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

operations.name: Update a template
operations.description: Update an existing template by its unique identifier.

id.description: Unique identifier for the template. Either the UUID or the urlId is acceptable.

data.description: The body of the template as a Prosemirror document.

icon.description: An emoji to use as the template icon.

color.description: The color of the template icon in hex format.

fullWidth.description: Whether the template should be displayed full width.

collectionId.description: Identifier for the collection to which the template belongs. Set to null for a workspace-wide template.

publish.description: Set to true to publish a draft template so it becomes available to other members.

operations.name: List document memberships
operations.description: List the documents that have been shared directly with the authenticated user, along with the associated membership records.

operations.name: Update a document membership
operations.description: Update the authenticated user's membership of a shared document, used to reorder documents in the sidebar.

id.description: Unique identifier for the membership.

index.description: The fractional index to move the document to in the sidebar.

operations.name: Activate a user
operations.description: Activating a previously suspended user allows them to signin again. Users that are activated will cause billing totals to be re-calculated in the hosted version.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user.

operations.name: Delete a user
operations.description: Deleting a user removes the object entirely. In almost every circumstance it is preferable to suspend a user, as a deleted user can be recreated by signing in with SSO again.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user.

operations.name: Retrieve a user
operations.description: Retrieve the details of a user by their unique identifier, including their name, email, avatar, and role within the workspace.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user.

operations.name: Invite users
operations.description: Send email invitations to one or more users to join the workspace. Invitations include a link to create an account and join the workspace.

suppressEmail.description: If true, the invitation emails will not be sent to the invited users. Defaults to false.

operations.name: List all users
operations.description: List and filter all the users in the workspace

operations.name: Subscribe to a notification type
operations.description: Enable a specific type of notification for the authenticated user. This controls which events the user receives email and in-app notifications for.

eventType.description: The notification event type to subscribe to.

operations.name: Unsubscribe from a notification type
operations.description: Disable a specific type of notification for the authenticated user.

eventType.description: The notification event type to unsubscribe from.

operations.name: Resend a user invite
operations.description: Resend the invitation email to a user who has been invited but has not yet signed in. Only applies to users in the invited state.

id.description: Identifier for the invited user.

operations.name: Suspend a user
operations.description: Suspending a user prevents the user from signing in. Users that are suspended are also not counted against billing totals in the hosted version.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user.

operations.name: Update a user
operations.description: Update a users name or avatar. If no `id` is passed then the user associated with the authentication will be updated by default.

preferences.description: User-level preference flags. Only the fields supplied are updated; existing values for other preferences are preserved.

operations.name: Update a user's email
operations.description: Begin the process of changing a user's email address. For security the email is not changed immediately; a confirmation link is sent to the new address and the change only takes effect once that link is followed.

email.description: The new email address to change to.

id.description: The user to update. Defaults to the authenticated user. Changing another user's email requires admin permission.

operations.name: Change a users role
operations.description: Change the role of a user, only available to admin authorization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user.

operations.name: List all views
operations.description: List all users that have viewed a document and the overall view count.

documentId.description: The document ID to retrieve views for

includeSuspended.description: Whether to include views from suspended users

operations.name: Create a webhook subscription
operations.description: Create a webhook subscription for the workspace. Only workspace administrators can access this endpoint.

name.description: A descriptive name for the webhook subscription.

url.description: The URL that receives webhook requests. Cloud-hosted workspaces require an HTTPS URL.

events.description: Event names or namespaces that trigger the webhook. Use `*` to subscribe to all events.

operations.name: Delete a webhook subscription
operations.description: Delete a webhook subscription. Only workspace administrators can access this endpoint.

id.description: Unique identifier for the webhook subscription.

operations.name: List all webhook subscriptions
operations.description: List all webhook subscriptions for the workspace. Only workspace administrators can access this endpoint.

operations.name: Update a webhook subscription
operations.description: Update an existing webhook subscription. Updating a disabled subscription enables it again. Only workspace administrators can access this endpoint.

id.description: Unique identifier for the webhook subscription.

name.description: A descriptive name for the webhook subscription.

url.description: The URL that receives webhook requests. Cloud-hosted workspaces require an HTTPS URL.

events.description: Event names or namespaces that trigger the webhook. Use `*` to subscribe to all events.
